# Diagnostic codes whose catalog default severity is `error`: the codes
# that can make a --validate result `valid: false`.
#
# This list is part of the CLI contract (catalog/features/cli_contract.md
# A13). Adding a code here makes previously valid code invalid, and
# removing or renaming one breaks consumers that key off it. Either way
# the change is BREAKING under DECISIONS.md D16: it ships in a minor
# release with a `### Breaking` CHANGELOG note. Update this file in the
# same commit as that note.
